metadata.transformation: For each real U.S. session t after the first valid OHLC row, the overnight synthetic bar is previous real close[t-1] -> current real open[t]. The synthetic USD open is FX-adjusted so the existing current-date CNY conversion reconstructs previous-close CNY value exactly; the synthetic close is current open. The daytime control is current real open -> current real close.
metadata.timing_note: The candidate represents economic exposure from U.S. close[t-1] until U.S. open[t], with no daytime equity exposure.
